BR_Mojave.text: THE MOJAVE / AMERICAN SOUTHWEST — immense, beautiful, sunlit high desert with sandstone cliffs, mesas, dry lake beds, slot canyons, escarpments and long clear horizons. Treat the landscape as spectacular adventure country, not a filthy wasteland or junkyard. Salvager sites are purposeful working camps integrated into the terrain.
